name: core.openwop.workflows.market-intel
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0149/0150 + ADR 0174). Market-intelligence digest + a SHIFT digest (research the current period, then diff against the prior run via market-intel.shift-detect → an in-voice shift summary) authored over PUBLISHED node packs (vendor.myndhyve.market-intel-* + core.openwop.ai) plus the host-native `core.web.fetch` (ADR 1116): they read the pages discovery finds (ADR 1135: discovery runs up to 2 live searches and orders the fetch list so hosts that block automated reads go last; a run with no readable source fails typed at discover), so they run only on a host that exposes `ctx.webResearch`, and fail typed at the fetch step elsewhere. Published under the `core.openwop.workflows.*` namespace (openwop-team signing key); the registry adds `signing` at publish time.
author: openwop

chains.label: Competitive / market-intel digest
chains.description: Discover sources for a topic, fetch and read the top pages, extract voice-of-customer quotes from each, score opportunities, then synthesize a digest with recommended actions. Needs a host with web research (core.web.fetch, ADR 1116); not portable to a host without it.

topic.description: The market/topic to research (e.g. 'AI workflow orchestration for mid-market ops teams').

audience.description: Optional audience framing for the synthesis.

icpContext.description: Who the research is for: { roles: [], industry, problems: [], outcomes: [] }. The voice-of-customer and scoring steps read it. An object, or the same object as JSON text.

productContext.description: What you sell: { name, category, differentiators: [] }. An object, or the same object as JSON text.

maxPages.description: How many fetched pages to read for voice-of-customer quotes. Each page is one AI call (default 3, at most 5).

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

config.systemPrompt: You are a market analyst. Synthesize a concise competitive/market-intel digest with recommended actions for the topic "{{params.topic}}"{{params.audience}}, using the discovered sources, voice-of-customer signals, and opportunity scores.

digest.description: The synthesized market-intel digest with recommended actions.

chains.label: Market-intel SHIFT digest (vs prior run)
chains.description: Research the current period (discover → voc → score), diff it against the PRIOR run's synthesized records/angles via market-intel.shift-detect, then synthesize a concise shift digest (what's new / resolved / intensifying + angle-score moves). The fetch step reads the top discovered pages (core.web.fetch, ADR 1116), so it needs a host with web research. The shift step outputs `snapshot` in the `previous` shape: feed it to the next run. Schedule it (RFC 0052) to get a recurring shift watch.

topic.description: The market/topic to re-research (same framing as the prior run).

icpContext.description: Who the research is for: { roles: [], industry, problems: [], outcomes: [] }. The voice-of-customer and scoring steps read it. An object, or the same object as JSON text.

productContext.description: What you sell: { name, category, differentiators: [] }. An object, or the same object as JSON text.

maxPages.description: How many fetched pages to read for voice-of-customer quotes. Each page is one AI call (default 3, at most 5).

previous.description: The PRIOR run's synthesized result — { records: [{quote,tagType,confidence?}], angles: [{id|name,score}] } — to diff against.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

config.systemPrompt: You are a market analyst. Given the detected market shift (new / resolved / intensifying pain points and angle-score deltas) for the topic "{{params.topic}}", write a concise SHIFT digest: what changed since the last run and the recommended next actions. If no material shift was detected, say so plainly.

shiftDigest.description: The synthesized market-shift digest (what changed + recommended actions).
